segments.t: What changed in the current release. The version this guide was built for is shown in the footer.

KTPH000Compare and synchronize foldersKTPH001 — KTPH002CompareKTPH003 reads both folders, the local one and the one on the server, with all subfolders, counts what is only on one side, newer or different, and colours the rows. KTPH004To the serverKTPH005 and KTPH006To this computerKTPH007 copy what is missing or newer, keep modification times, and can delete what exists only on the target. See KTPH008Comparing and synchronizing foldersKTPH009.

KTPH000File comparison with AI questions and a new file from bothKTPH001 — select two files, two in one panel or one in each, also a local one against one on the server, and click KTPH002CompareKTPH003 to see them side by side. With the AI features on, KTPH004Ask AIKTPH005 explains where they differ, what the differences do or what could be improved, for example in scripts and configuration files, and KTPH006New fileKTPH007 has the AI write a third file from both, which you can save on the server or on this computer or keep in the Snippet Manager. Two folders on the same side can be compared as well. See KTPH008Comparing two filesKTPH009.

KTPH004Active panel, path bar and status lineKTPH005 — the panel you clicked or typed in last is framed in the accent colour; each panel has its own row of buttons under its list, with KTPH006UploadKTPH007 and KTPH008DownloadKTPH009 facing each other across the divider. Each panel shows its path as clickable folders (KTPH010KTPH000KTPH011+KTPH012KTPH001KTPH013 or KTPH014KTPH002KTPH015+KTPH016KTPH003KTPH017 to type one) and a line under the list with the number of entries, the selection and its size. Rows are compact in every design. See KTPH018Active panelKTPH019 and KTPH020Path bar and status lineKTPH021.

KTPH006Hidden files and sort orderKTPH007 — an eye button beside each panel's path, or KTPH008KTPH000KTPH009+KTPH010KTPH001KTPH011+KTPH012KTPH002KTPH013 (KTPH014KTPH003KTPH015+KTPH016KTPH004KTPH017+KTPH018KTPH005KTPH019 on Windows and Linux), shows or hides dot files and folders (and Windows hidden files); each panel remembers its choice. Hidden folders come first, then hidden files, folders and files, in every column. See KTPH020Hidden filesKTPH021 and KTPH022Sort orderKTPH023.

KTPH000Permission checkboxesKTPH001 — KTPH002Set Owner/PermissionsKTPH003 shows the mode as checkboxes for owner, group and others next to the octal field and keeps both in step. On the local side the user, the group and KTPH004Apply recursively to directoriesKTPH005 now take effect. See KTPH006PermissionsKTPH007.

KTPH001User and group names, folder sizesKTPH002 — servers that send owners only as numbers, such as OpenSSH, now show user and group names, looked up on the server in the background. KTPH003Calculate sizeKTPH004 in the server's right-click menu measures folders with KTPH000, and the size estimate in the archive dialog now includes the selected folders. See KTPH005Owner and group namesKTPH006 and KTPH007Folder sizesKTPH008.

KTPH000Archive dialog says what it archivesKTPH001 — the computer, the folder, the number of folders and files and their names. The server's archive tools are looked up in the background, so a server that runs no commands no longer freezes the window. See KTPH002Creating archivesKTPH003.

KTPH000Search in the settingsKTPH001 — a search line at the top of KTPH002Global SettingsKTPH003 finds a setting on any tab as you type. Choosing a result opens its tab, scrolls to the setting, colours it and focuses its control. See KTPH004Searching the settingsKTPH005.

KTPH000Manual for each tab and sectionKTPH001 — KTPH002Manual for this pageKTPH003 in the settings navigation bar opens the built-in manual at the page for the current tab, and the section headers on the Logging, Resources, Security and Privacy tabs link to the section that explains them. The Logging tab now says that it concerns korTTY's own application log, not terminal session logs. See KTPH004Manual for each tabKTPH005.

KTPH000Automatic encrypted backupKTPH001 — KTPH002Settings → Backup → Automatic backupKTPH003 creates a backup on a schedule (daily, weekly or monthly) into a folder you choose, always encrypted, and catches up a backup that was missed while korTTY was closed. A status line says when the last one ran and when the next is due; an organization policy can lock the setting. See KTPH004Automatic backupKTPH005.

KTPH000Translation profilesKTPH001 — KTPH002Settings → TranslationKTPH003 keeps several translation profiles, one of them the default, with a setup assistant for a new one. KTPH004Translate nowKTPH005 shows an estimate before it starts and can be paused and cancelled. See KTPH006Translation profilesKTPH007 and KTPH008Translate nowKTPH009.

KTPH001Theme previewKTPH002 — the Themes tab shows the theme list in a narrow column and previews the selected theme on a sample terminal screen with a directory listing, KTPH000, compiler messages, all sixteen ANSI colours and the theme's cursor. See KTPH003Theme previewKTPH004.

KTPH000AI settings in the AI ManagerKTPH001 — the AI tab of Global Settings moved into the AI Manager's new KTPH002GeneralKTPH003 tab, which holds the options that belong to no profile: features and safety, the terminal agent, defaults and internet access. See KTPH004General tabKTPH005.

KTPH000Profile editor in sectionsKTPH001 — the KTPH002ProfilesKTPH003 tab keeps the profile name and KTPH004Use as default profileKTPH005 at the top and groups the fields into KTPH006ConnectionKTPH007, KTPH008Model KTPH024 capabilitiesKTPH009, KTPH010Limits KTPH025 timeoutsKTPH011 and KTPH012Budget KTPH026 usageKTPH013. Only the rows of the selected connection mode are shown, the request timeout that applies to every profile heads the Limits KTPH027 timeouts section, and KTPH014Test AI ConnectionKTPH015, KTPH016DeleteKTPH017 and KTPH018SaveKTPH019 sit under the editor. See KTPH020AI ManagerKTPH021. KTPH022Test AI ConnectionKTPH023 shows its result in a coloured bar under the profile name instead of only in the status line.

KTPH000Profile setup wizardKTPH001 — a sidebar shows the stages and the choices already made, a KTPH002Quick startKTPH003 finds LM Studio, Ollama (on this computer, on the hosts you enter under KTPH004Other computers on the networkKTPH005, and on the hosts of existing profiles) and installed command-line tools and offers one-click profiles, connection types and providers are cards, reasoning sits under KTPH006AdvancedKTPH007, and the last step runs the test by itself and shows a summary with KTPH008ChangeKTPH009 links. See KTPH010AI Profile Setup WizardKTPH011.

KTPH000Local AI in sectionsKTPH001 — the KTPH002Local AIKTPH003 tab splits into KTPH004Profile rolesKTPH005, KTPH006Local runtimeKTPH007 and KTPH008Hugging FaceKTPH009. See KTPH010Text, coding, translation, and embedding rolesKTPH011.

KTPH000Job dependenciesKTPH001 — a job can depend on other jobs and either keep its own schedule but only run when every predecessor's last run succeeded (KTPH002ConditionKTPH003), or start automatically once all predecessors have succeeded (KTPH004ChainKTPH005), optionally only counting recent successes. Cycles are refused, the job list shows a KTPH006Depends onKTPH007 column, and deleting a job that others depend on warns first. KTPH008Run with successorsKTPH009 runs a job and everything below it in dependency order, and KTPH010Disable chainKTPH011 switches a job and all its dependents off or on at once. See KTPH012Job DependenciesKTPH013.

KTPH000Dependency diagramKTPH001 — draws the job dependencies as a Mermaid flowchart colored by each job's last result, vertical or horizontal, in light or dark mode, with SVG/PNG export. See KTPH002Dependency DiagramKTPH003.

KTPH001Reconnected tunnels get their ports backKTPH002 — after a reconnect, a remote (KTPH000) tunnel could fail with KTPH003Address already in useKTPH004 because korTTY asked for the port again before the server had released it. korTTY now waits for the server to release a remote forward before it hands the tunnel over. See KTPH005SSH TunnelsKTPH006.

KTPH000Snippet AI processing beside the analysisKTPH001 — the progress of applying a full code analysis sits in an KTPH002AI processingKTPH003 column at the snippet editor's right edge, sized to its checklist, and can be moved into the analysis panel. See KTPH004Applying the selected improvementsKTPH005.
KTPH000JobScheduler time windows show their timesKTPH001 — the KTPH002Window fromKTPH003 and KTPH004Window untilKTPH005 fields no longer cut the selected time off.
